10-count-ginger-limeaid.tagline: Your go-to, all-day powerhouse. Bright, bold, and built for hydration.
10-count-ginger-limeaid.story: Ginger LimeAid is our #1 seller for a reason. The brightness of real lime paired with warming ginger gives you something you'll actually crave — not just tolerate. It's the one Pam reaches for every morning before anything else.
10-count-ginger-limeaid.howToUse: Mix one scoop into 12–16 oz of cold water. Drink before, during, or after exercise — or any time you need to feel human again.
10-count-ginger-limeaid.flavorNote: Bright and citrusy with a warm ginger finish. Not sweet. Refreshing.

10-count-hibiscus-lime.tagline: Floral, tart, and unexpectedly beautiful. Like summer in a jar.
10-count-hibiscus-lime.story: Hibiscus Lime is the one that surprises people. It looks like a sunset in your glass and tastes like something you'd order at a fancy spa — except it's actually good for you. Real hibiscus, real lime. Nothing fake.
10-count-hibiscus-lime.howToUse: Mix one scoop into 12–16 oz of cold water. Gorgeous over ice. Works especially well on hot days when you need hydration that feels like a treat.
10-count-hibiscus-lime.flavorNote: Floral and tart with a hint of sweetness. Light and refreshing.

10-count-chocolate-cordyceps-1.tagline: Your recovery flavor. Rich chocolate + cordyceps for the afternoon slump.
10-count-chocolate-cordyceps-1.story: This one is different. Real chocolate + cordyceps mushroom — a combination Pam developed specifically for recovery days. Cordyceps has been used for centuries to support energy and endurance. Paired with the richness of real chocolate, it's the one you reach for after a hard effort.
10-count-chocolate-cordyceps-1.howToUse: Mix one scoop into 12–16 oz of water. Best after workouts or in the afternoon. Can also be mixed into warm water for a cozy drink.
10-count-chocolate-cordyceps-1.flavorNote: Rich and chocolatey with earthy depth. Satisfying, not sweet.

10-serving-passion-cherry.tagline: The sweetest one. Smooth, ripe, and easy to crave any time of day.
10-serving-passion-cherry.story: Passion Cherry is the flavor people ask for when they're new to Purest and want something approachable. Real freeze-dried passionfruit and tart cherry — smooth, ripe, and genuinely delicious. The one that converts skeptics.
10-serving-passion-cherry.howToUse: Mix one scoop into 12–16 oz of cold water. The most crowd-pleasing flavor — great for sharing.
10-serving-passion-cherry.flavorNote: Smooth and fruity with a natural sweetness. The most approachable flavor.

10-servings-cranberry.tagline: Crisp, refreshing, and perfectly tart. The one that wakes you up.
10-servings-cranberry.story: Cranberry Mint is bold and bracing — the one you reach for when you need to wake up and get moving. Real cranberry with a clean mint finish. It's polarizing in the best way: people who love it, love it.
10-servings-cranberry.howToUse: Mix one scoop into 12–16 oz of cold water. Especially refreshing over ice or after outdoor winter activity.
10-servings-cranberry.flavorNote: Tart and crisp with a cooling mint finish. Bold and refreshing.

20-count-variety-pack.tagline: Try all 5 flavors. Find your favorite. Five days of real hydration.
20-count-variety-pack.story: Not sure where to start? This is your answer. Five single-serve vials — one of each flavor — so you can try everything and find the one you'll actually stick with. Pam's recommendation: start here.
20-count-variety-pack.howToUse: Each vial makes one serving. Mix with 12–16 oz of cold water. Try a different flavor each day.
20-count-variety-pack.flavorNote: All five flavors in one kit: Ginger LimeAid, Hibiscus Lime, Chocolate Cordyceps, Passion Cherry, and Cranberry Mint.

free-purest-glass-water-bottle.tagline: Pure taste, zero plastic. The perfect companion for your daily hydration ritual.
free-purest-glass-water-bottle.story: Plastic leaches. Glass doesn't. Our glass water bottle is designed to go with you everywhere — made to pair with your Purest jar so your hydration ritual is complete from first scoop to last sip.
bestFor: Daily use at home or office
free-purest-glass-water-bottle.howToUse: Add your Purest scoop directly to the bottle, fill with cold water, shake, and go. Dishwasher safe.
free-purest-glass-water-bottle.flavorNote: No plastic taste. Just pure water and Purest.
